shared_elements: circle or disc motif placed on the central vertical axis
upright monolithic slab-like format with rounded top
justification: Both are upright, roughly rounded-topped stone monuments whose incised decoration includes a prominent disc on the central axis with curved bands beneath it, which is the only concrete correspondence. Otherwise they are utterly unlike: A carries a handful of large, crude, deeply pecked motifs on a sculptural three-dimensional body, while B is a dense, finely drawn, register-based composition of standing figures, radiating lines and packed columns of script.
